VI.description: Write direction\2C step 1. Builds a VI with VI Scripting alone - no ConvertAIXMLToVI anywhere - and saves it. New VI creates the target\2C New VI Object drops one Add node on its diagram\2C Save.Instrument writes it to the given path. The style input is the interesting part\3A NI's own example feeds it a 2177-item Ring constant of palette names\2C but a Ring is numeric on the wire\2C so this feeds the code directly. items[7]=Add pairs with values[7]=1050. If a plain number is accepted\2C a data-driven generator needs no giant constant at all. Drive it with one string input\3A the full path of the VI to create.
